name: Phoenix Rebirth #86 — Zeus & Hades, Twin Thrones of Heaven and Underworld
description: Sons of Kronos. Rulers of divided realms. Zeus commands thunder, sovereignty, and the high architecture of heaven. Hades governs the unseen dominion below, where endings harden into law and silence becomes power. In Greek myth they are not opposites, but structural halves of one cosmos. In their Phoenix reincarnation, lightning and abyss no longer stand apart. They are reborn as twin thrones of balance — heaven above, underworld below, judgment held between brilliance and shadow. This is not conflict, but the geometry of existence itself.
